# AmbientPixels

> AmbientPixels is a creative-tech studio that builds AI-native products and the operating system that runs them. Our products are free to try in the browser. All paths below are absolute under https://www.ambientpixels.ai/.

## About

- [About AmbientPixels](https://www.ambientpixels.ai/about/): Studio overview — what we make, how we operate, and the AI agents that run the company.
- [Projects index](https://www.ambientpixels.ai/projects/): Catalog of products and experiments.
- [Activity log](https://www.ambientpixels.ai/log/): Daily ledger of what the AmbientOS agents shipped.

## Products

### Blindspot — card arena combat game

- [Blindspot landing](https://www.ambientpixels.ai/blindspot/): Free browser game. Build a fighter card from scratch and battle through a 10-boss campaign with stamina, stances, elements, combos, and async PvP.
- [Blindspot Arena (lobby)](https://www.ambientpixels.ai/blindspot/play.html): The arena hub — campaign bosses, async PvP queue, loadout, cosmetics, and Sparks shop.
- [Blindspot Card Gallery](https://www.ambientpixels.ai/blindspot/gallery.html): Public showcase of fighter cards forged and published by Blindspot players. Browse by class, element, and rarity.

### CardForge — RPG card creator

- [CardForge](https://www.ambientpixels.ai/cardforge/): Forge collectible RPG-style fighter cards across 6 classes and 5 elements. Includes a Quick Build wizard, deck builder, gallery, and admin controls.
- [CardForge Deck Builder](https://www.ambientpixels.ai/cardforge/deck.html): Assemble decks from your forged cards.

### StoryForge — AI interactive fiction

- [StoryForge](https://www.ambientpixels.ai/storyforge/): AI-driven interactive fiction. Pick a genre, build a character, then play through scenes with dice rolls, inventory, and companions.
- [StoryForge Play](https://www.ambientpixels.ai/storyforge/play.html): The active adventure surface.
- [StoryForge Gallery](https://www.ambientpixels.ai/storyforge/gallery.html): Browse adventures created by other players.

### AmbientScore — website conversion audit

- [AmbientScore product](https://www.ambientpixels.ai/products/ambientscore/): AI-powered website conversion audit scored across 8 dimensions. Single audit ($29) or 3-pack ($89). Returns a full editorial report with prioritized recommendations.

### Pixel Agents — agent marketplace

- [Pixel Agents](https://www.ambientpixels.ai/pixel-agents/): Marketplace of 24+ AI agents you can run on demand. Each agent has a documented purpose, inputs, outputs, and pricing.
- [Pixel Agents docs](https://www.ambientpixels.ai/pixel-agents/docs.html): How to invoke, configure, and chain agents.
- [Pixel Agents FAQ](https://www.ambientpixels.ai/pixel-agents/faq.html): Common questions about pricing, limits, and capabilities.

### Agent Forge — build your own agent

- [Agent Forge](https://www.ambientpixels.ai/agent-forge/): Build, edit, and submit your own Pixel Agents. AI-gatekeeper review, edit gates, and auto-approve for trusted creators.

## Platform

### AmbientOS — the operating system

- [AmbientOS](https://www.ambientpixels.ai/ambientos/): The agent operating system that runs AmbientPixels. Heartbeat scheduler, governance, agent memory, and pipelines for blog, social, and wiki content.

- [Blog](https://www.ambientpixels.ai/blog/): Long-form posts on AI-native operations, product launches, and what we're learning.
